VoxLution achieves scene generation at a finer voxel resolution than existing baselines, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks with 59.6% lower FPD and 51.1% lower FID on 3D-FRONT, and 70.5% lower FPD and 73.8% lower FID on Scannet++.

items.title_en: Altered Visual Hand Feedback in Virtual Reality: An Exploratory Study in Essential Tremor
items.abstract_en: Pathological tremor is the most prevalent movement disorder worldwide, characterized by involuntary muscular oscillations within a frequency of 3 to 12 Hz. Despite extensive research, the underlying mechanisms that generate and modulate tremor are not yet understood, and treatments are usually insufficient. While it is known that visual feedback is an important afferent pathway, little is known about the impact of altering the hand's visual representation on tremor expression. With the development of immersive technologies, VR poses an excellent tool to study how alterations to the representation of the hands affect tremor. In this work, we study this through two complementary experiments. In the first one, we show that a consumer-level hand-tracking system substantially attenuates tremor-band movements without preventing successful task completion. In the second one, with eight patients with essential tremor, we observe task-dependent differences in physical tremor between VR and the real world, with several patients exhibiting lower tremor-band activity in both hand kinematics and muscle oscillations, particularly during reaching tasks. Our findings represent an initial step toward validating the use of VR as an experimental tool for the research and treatment of pathological tremor, while highlighting strong user- and task-dependent effects.

items.title_en: VariaFlow: Uncertainty-Aware Flow Matching for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
items.abstract_en: Reconstruction-based anomaly detection no longer fails at reconstruction. Generative models produce high-quality pseudo-healthy reconstructions, and the remaining difficulty is the step of scoring residuals. The residual between a scan and its reconstruction has two indistinguishable sources, genuine pathology and the anatomical variation that separates one healthy brain from another. Scoring against a single reconstruction treats both as anomalous, inflating false positives where healthy anatomy varies most while small or subtle lesions are lost in the surrounding reconstruction error. We identify the missing quantity as the predictive variance, how much a healthy reconstruction can vary at each location. We introduce VariaFlow, which estimates this variance from an ensemble of mask-guided restorations under an unconditional flow matching prior, each started from a different noise initialization, and which normalizes the residual by the resulting standard deviation. Few-step flow matching keeps the ensemble computationally affordable, and restoring at two spatial scales captures lesions of different size. Across three brain MRI datasets spanning stroke and tumor, VariaFlow is trained once on healthy anatomy and generalizes across all three, attaining the highest AUROC (0.94, 0.80, 0.78) on each and the highest AUPRC on both cross-domain datasets, exceeding the strongest baseline by 37% and 50%. Under domain shift, the same baseline drops by up to 52% in AUPRC, whereas VariaFlow stays more stable and achieves the best small-lesion Dice on all three datasets.

items.title_en: BDNet: Fast-slow thinking is all you need
items.abstract_en: We present BDNet, a hierarchical image-classification backbone built around fast image features and slow statistical references. Its baseline deformation operator (BDO) transforms the deviation of a feature from a stage-specific reference through a low-rank projection and a learned channel scale. Rather than computing pairwise token similarity, the branch operates directly on baseline-relative residuals with complexity linear in the token count. Each of four reference buffers accumulates detached stage statistics during training and remains frozen at inference. A four-stage pyramid with depths $(2,2,6,2)$ and widths $(96,192,384,768)$ yields a 20.70M-parameter classifier at $224\times224$ resolution. We organize an ImageNet-1K study around clean classification, eight controlled ablations, and Gaussian-noise, contrast, and brightness perturbations. The central hypothesis is that a slow reference can improve the robustness of a compact representation while retaining a simple tensor implementation. We distinguish this training-time statistical mechanism from input-dependent attention and make its linear inference behavior explicit.

items.title_en: Beyond Trial-and-Error: A Geospatial-Guided Active Reasoning Framework for Robust Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation
items.abstract_en: Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires UAVs to locate language-specified goals in large-scale urban environments, where objects often appear small and visually ambiguous from high-altitude viewpoints. Existing methods largely follow a reactive paradigm common in indoor VLN, repeatedly updating navigation states from local observations while underutilizing the geospatial structure that remains stable during navigation. As a result, visually similar distractors can cause a reactive goal search to repeatedly reinforce locally plausible goal hypotheses based on passively accumulated evidence, leading to unreliable localization. To address this, we propose GeoReasoner, a robust framework that shifts the paradigm of Aerial VLN from reactive trial-and-error to geospatial-guided active reasoning. Specifically, GeoReasoner first performs pre-search geospatial reasoning to derive region-level priors and constrain the goal hypothesis space. Building on these, it further conducts hypothesis-driven exploration to actively acquire discriminative evidence and refine competing goal hypotheses. Finally, consistency-aware goal verification adversarially assesses complementary evidence sources before stopping, hence reducing premature or erroneous goal confirmations. Experiments on the real-world CityNav benchmark demonstrate that GeoReasoner sets a new SOTA among zero-shot Aerial VLN methods while competing favorably with supervised approaches.

items.title_en: FlexReader: Towards Adaptive Decoding Paths for Efficient Arbitrary-Length Scene Text Recognition
items.abstract_en: Existing Scene Text Recognition (STR) models are inherently coupled with a specific decoding strategy by their training paradigms, limiting their flexibility in deployment across diverse recognition scenarios. In this paper, we propose FlexReader, an STR model that supports multiple decoding strides, enabling a single model to achieve an optimal accuracy-efficiency trade-off across different datasets. Specifically, we first introduce a Sub-string Perception module to perceive the target sub-string from visual features, followed by multiple parallel decoding blocks that independently decode each character in the sub-string. During inference, FlexReader supports decoding with arbitrary strides within the perceived sub-string range. Furthermore, we propose Adaptive Prefix Decoding, which adaptively selects the decoding stride at each step based on the model's confidence in the decoded characters, thereby identifying the optimal decoding path for each input. Experimental results demonstrate that FlexReader exhibits robust recognition capability across a diverse range of benchmarks, including those featuring long text, curved text, and occlusions. It consistently outperforms existing decoding strategies in recognition accuracy while achieving up to 6-flod decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding.

items.title_en: Multi-modal in situ profiling of human cells using the AVITI24 platform characterizes single-cell responses to acute stress
items.title_zh: 利用 AVITI24 平台对人类细胞进行多模态原位分析，刻画单细胞对急性应激的响应
items.abstract_en: Cells begin to respond to stress within minutes, but how this early response depends on cell type, neighboring cells, or cell cycle phase has been difficult to determine, because bulk assays average across cells and synchronization can induce stress. We measured 338 transcripts, 48 proteins and phosphoproteins, and six cell paint stains in situ in 1.18 million single cells from four human cell lines exposed to H2O2, alone and in co-culture, and in A549 cells exposed to TNF-, cadmium, dithiothreitol or lipopolysaccharide. In A549 cells, five distinct stressors changed the same targets in the same direction within 15 min, differing mainly in magnitude, and modestly increased JNK phosphorylation. By 30 min of H2O2 treatment, immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, DDIT3, DUSP1, NR4A1) were induced most strongly in HCT116 and A549 cells. These changes occurred across the whole cell population rather than in a responsive subset. Cell line-specific differences persisted in co-culture, and the response of MCF7 cells did not increase with the number of adjacent, strongly-responding A549 cells. Ordering cells along the cell cycle from the same measurements identified 106 cycle-associated transcripts, and the response varied more between cell lines than among cell cycle phases. Overall, the measured regulators respond to stress within 30 minutes through a largely shared program whose magnitude depends more on cell identity than on cell cycle state or neighboring cell type.
items.abstract_zh: 细胞在数分钟内即启动应激响应，但群体检测会平均化信号、同步化处理本身又会诱发应激，使该早期响应如何依赖细胞类型、邻近细胞与细胞周期一直难以解析。研究者在 AVITI24 平台上对来自四种人细胞系的 118 万个单细胞进行原位检测，同时测量 338 个转录本、48 种蛋白与磷酸化蛋白及 6 种细胞涂染标记，涵盖单独培养与共培养下暴露于 H2O2 的细胞，以及暴露于 TNF-α、镉、二硫苏糖醇或脂多糖的 A549 细胞。结果显示：五种不同应激源在 15 分钟内以相同方向改变同一批靶标，仅幅度不同，并轻度升高 JNK 磷酸化；H2O2 处理 30 分钟时，即刻早期基因（FOS、JUN、DDIT3、DUSP1、NR4A1）在 HCT116 与 A549 中诱导最强。这些变化发生于整个细胞群体而非某一响应亚群；共培养下细胞系特异差异依然存在，MCF7 的响应并不随邻近强响应 A549 细胞数量增加而增强。由同一测量将细胞按细胞周期排序，鉴定出 106 个周期相关转录本，而响应差异在细胞系间大于周期各阶段之间。总体上，所测调控因子在 30 分钟内通过一套高度共享的程序响应应激，其幅度更多取决于细胞身份而非周期状态或邻近细胞类型。
items.highlight_zh: 单细胞原位多组学显示急性应激响应是全群体共享程序，强弱取决于细胞身份
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：细胞受到应激后几分钟内就会作出反应，但传统“批量”检测把成千上万个细胞混在一起测，只能得到平均值，看不出个体差异；而用药物把细胞周期“同步”又会本身造成应激。因此，早期应激反应是否因细胞类型、相邻细胞或细胞周期而异，长期没有答案。
方法：作者用 AVITI24 平台做原位、多模态的单细胞测量——在同一批细胞里同时读出 338 个转录本、48 种蛋白与磷酸化蛋白、6 种细胞涂染染色，共分析四种人细胞系的 118 万个单细胞，包括单独培养与共培养下暴露于 H2O2，以及 A549 细胞暴露于 TNF-α、镉、DTT、脂多糖。
结果：一，A549 中五种完全不同的应激源在 15 分钟内改变同一批靶标、方向相同，只是幅度不同，并轻度升高 JNK 磷酸化；二，H2O2 处理 30 分钟内，即刻早期基因（FOS、JUN、DDIT3、DUSP1、NR4A1）在 HCT116 与 A549 中诱导最强；三，这种变化遍布整个细胞群体，而不是只发生在某个“特别敏感”的亚群；四，共培养时各细胞系的特异差异照旧保留，MCF7 的反应也没有因为旁边有更多强响应的 A549 而变强；五，用同一批数据把细胞沿细胞周期排序，找到 106 个与周期相关的转录本，但应激响应的差异在细胞系之间远大于在周期各阶段之间。
为何重要：它说明急性应激的早期响应是一套高度共享的“通用程序”，强度主要由细胞身份决定，而非周期状态或邻居细胞。这既纠正了“只有少数细胞在响应”的直觉，也展示了单细胞多组学原位检测在应激生物学、药物与毒理筛选中的潜力。

items.title_en: A Precisely Controlled Long-Acting Immunosuppression Platform Enables Prolonged Survival of Vascularized Composite Allografts
items.title_zh: 一种精确可控的长效免疫抑制平台使血管化复合异体移植物获得长期存活
items.abstract_en: Vascularized composite allotransplantation (VCA) restores complex multi-tissue defects but remains limited by the need for lifelong immunosuppression. Daily oral tacrolimus, the primary maintenance regimen, poses adherence challenges and produces large peak-trough fluctuations within a narrow therapeutic window, resulting in toxicity and periods of under-immunosuppression. Although injectable depots could improve adherence, existing systems frequently generate prolonged supratherapeutic exposure. Most rely primarily on depot matrix properties to govern release kinetics, which alone are insufficient, and in certain systems uncontrolled solvent efflux during phase inversion can exacerbate early burst release. To address these limitations, we developed PRECISE (Programmable, Retrievable, Embedded Controlled ImmunoSuppression Encapsulator), a graft-injectable, in situ-forming depot engineered to precisely regulate systemic tacrolimus exposure. PRECISE integrates a polymeric matrix with rationally selected small-molecule excipients that interact with tacrolimus at the molecular level and modulate solvent dynamics during phase inversion, enabling release control beyond polymer tuning alone. Notably, rapamycin, under select dosing conditions, can also interact with tacrolimus and regulate solvent dynamics, enabling controlled co-delivery of a complementary immunosuppressive combination. This integration of drug-excipient and drug-drug interactions introduces a previously unexplored mechanism for controlling systemic exposure in in situ-forming depots. In a rat hindlimb transplant model, monthly intragraft administration of PRECISE maintained systemic tacrolimus and rapamycin concentrations within the therapeutic window for over 300 days, prolonged graft survival, expanded regulatory T cells, and induced donor-specific hyporesponsiveness. Translational validation in fully MHC-mismatched (SLA Class I and II) pigs, one of the most stringent large-animal transplant models, demonstrated sustained therapeutic drug levels, preserved graft vascular integrity, and graft survival through 90 days. Collectively, these findings establish PRECISE as the first long-acting immunosuppressive platform to maintain systemic drug concentrations precisely within the therapeutic window while enabling controlled dual-drug immunosuppression and the first long-acting immunosuppressive system validated in a fully MHC-mismatched large-animal VCA model, with broad applicability to solid-organ transplantation.
items.abstract_zh: 血管化复合异体移植（VCA）可修复复杂的多组织缺损，但受限于需终身免疫抑制。每日口服他克莫司依从性差，且在狭窄治疗窗内峰谷波动大，易致毒性并出现免疫抑制不足的时段。可注射储库虽能改善依从性，但现有系统常造成长期超治疗浓度暴露；其释放动力学多主要依赖储库基质性质，单靠这一手段并不充分，某些体系在相转化过程中不受控的溶剂外流还会加剧早期突释。为此，作者开发了 PRECISE——一种可植入移植物、原位成形的储库，整合聚合物基质与经理性筛选的小分子辅料，后者在分子层面与他克莫司相互作用并调控相转化时的溶剂动力学，从而实现超越单纯聚合物调节的释放控制；在特定给药条件下，雷帕霉素同样可与他克莫司相互作用并调节溶剂动力学，实现互补免疫抑制组合的可控共递送。在大鼠后肢移植模型中，每月经移植物内给予 PRECISE，可使全身他克莫司与雷帕霉素浓度维持在治疗窗内超过 300 天，延长移植物存活并扩增调节性……（摘要原文至此截断）。
items.highlight_zh: 药物-辅料与药物-药物相互作用协同控释，实现超 300 天治疗窗内暴露
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：血管化复合异体移植（如手、面部、肢体移植）能修复大面积多组织缺损，但患者必须终身服用免疫抑制剂。主流方案是每天口服他克莫司，问题有三：患者容易漏服；药物在很窄的治疗窗内大幅峰谷波动，峰太高会中毒、谷太低则等于没有保护。改成注射型长效储库虽能提高依从性，但现有体系往往让药物长期处于超治疗浓度，副作用风险大。
方法：作者设计 PRECISE——一种可直接注射到移植物内、在原位成形的储库。它的核心不只是调聚合物配方，而是加入经理性筛选的小分子辅料，让这些辅料在分子层面与他克莫司结合，并在储库“相转化”成形的过程中调控溶剂运动，从而把释放曲线控得更精细；有意思的是，在特定剂量下雷帕霉素也能与他克莫司发生类似相互作用并调节溶剂动力学，于是两种互补的免疫抑制剂可以一起被可控释放，形成此前未被探索的控释机制。
结果：在大鼠后肢移植模型中，每月向移植物内注射一次 PRECISE，可把全身他克莫司与雷帕霉素浓度稳定维持在治疗窗内超过 300 天，移植物存活时间延长，调节性……（原文摘要在此截断，后续数据未见完整描述）。
为何重要：它把“控释”从单纯调材料，推进到利用药物-辅料和药物-药物相互作用来调控系统暴露，为需要长期、窄窗给药的移植患者提供了一种可能大幅降低服药负担、同时避免毒性与“免疫空窗”的新思路。

items.title_en: Stigma, Place, and HIV: The Legacy of the 1984 Bhopal Gas Disaster Among Indian Men Who Have Sex with Men
items.title_zh: 污名、地点与 HIV：1984 年博帕尔毒气灾难对印度男男性行为者的长久影响
items.abstract_en: Background The 1984 Bhopal Gas Leak is widely considered the worst industrial disaster in history, and "big events" can have durable impacts on infectious disease transmission. Among men who have sex with men, we examined whether meeting sexual partners near the original gas leak site was associated with HIV, HIV-associated risk behaviors, and sexual stigma. Methods We used respondent-driven sampling to enroll MSM in Bhopal during 2023-24 (n=750). Participants reported the four locations where they most often went to meet sexual partners in the past year. Sexual stigma was defined by mechanism (enacted, anticipated, internalized) and source (healthcare, family, society). We calculated weighted (RDS-II) prevalences of HIV, population-level HIV viremia ([≥]200 copies/ml), and associated risk behaviors by meeting location type and distance to the original gas leak site. We used weighted logistic regression to examine associations between sexual stigma and partner meeting locations. Results HIV prevalence was elevated among participants meeting near the leak site: 21.7% within 1 km, 14.4% between 1-2 km, and 9.7% over 2 km. Population-level HIV viremia and the proportion of MSM engaging in sex work were also elevated within 2 km. Sexual stigma measures were significantly associated with meeting a partner within 2 km of the leak site. Transportation-related spaces were associated with higher prevalences of HIV and viremia. Conclusions Industrial disasters may create marginal spaces which concentrate individuals facing greater stigma and elevated HIV transmission risk. Venue-based interventions near the gas leak site and at transportation centers may be warranted in Bhopal.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：1984 年博帕尔毒气泄漏被普遍视为史上最严重的工业灾难，而“大事件”可对传染病传播产生持久影响。本研究在男男性行为者（MSM）中考察：在原始毒气泄漏地点附近寻找性伴侣是否与 HIV 感染、HIV 相关危险行为及性污名相关。方法：采用应答者驱动抽样于 2023—2024 年在博帕尔招募 MSM（n=750），记录其过去一年最常寻找性伴侣的四个地点。性污名按机制（实际发生、预期、内化）与来源（医疗、家庭、社会）界定。按见面地点类型及距泄漏点距离，计算 HIV、群体水平 HIV 病毒血症（≥200 copies/ml）及相关危险行为的加权（RDS-II）患病率，并用加权 logistic 回归分析性污名与见面地点之间的关联。结果：在泄漏点附近见面的参与者 HIV 患病率升高：1 km 内为 21.7%，1—2 km 为 14.4%，2 km 以外为 9.7%；群体病毒血症与从事性工作的 MSM 比例在 2 km 内亦升高。多项性污名指标与在泄漏点 2 km 内见面显著相关；交通相关场所与更高的 HIV 及病毒血症患病率相关。结论：工业灾难可能造就边缘化空间，使承受更强污名、HIV 传播风险更高的人群聚集其中；博帕尔或需在毒气泄漏点附近及交通枢纽开展场所干预。
items.highlight_zh: 距博帕尔毒气泄漏点越近，MSM 的 HIV 患病率与污名水平越高
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：1984 年博帕尔毒气泄漏是史上最严重的工业灾难。作者关心的不是当年的伤亡，而是一个更长期的问题：这类“大事件”会在城市里留下什么样的社会空间，从而影响今天的传染病传播？具体而言，在男男性行为者（MSM）中，常去毒气泄漏点附近寻找性伴侣的人，是否更容易感染 HIV、更常出现高危行为、承受更强污名？
方法：研究团队 2023—2024 年在博帕尔用应答者驱动抽样（一种适合隐藏人群的滚雪球式抽样）招募了 750 名 MSM，请他们报告过去一年最常去的四个找伴地点。性污名按机制（实际遭遇、预期、内化）和来源（医疗、家庭、社会）分类测量。随后按见面地点类型与距泄漏点的距离，计算加权 HIV 患病率、群体病毒血症比例（≥200 copies/ml，即体内病毒未被抑制）和高危行为比例，并用加权 logistic 回归检验污名与地点之间的关系。
结果：距离效应非常明显——在泄漏点 1 km 内见面的 MSM，HIV 患病率 21.7%；1—2 km 为 14.4%；2 km 以外降到 9.7%。2 km 范围内的群体病毒血症比例和从事性工作的比例也更高；交通枢纽类场所同样对应更高的 HIV 与病毒血症患病率。多种性污名指标与“在 2 km 内见面”显著相关。
为何重要：它提示工业灾难会遗留“边缘空间”，把承受污名最重、风险最高的人聚集到特定地点，从而在地理上持续塑造 HIV 流行。因此干预不必只针对个人，而可在毒气泄漏点周边和交通站点开展场所干预，这也为理解重大事件对传染病的长期影响提供了新视角。

items.title_en: Deep learning grading of Schistosoma japonicum-associated liver fibrosis from ultrasound images: a weighted soft-voting ensemble of convolutional and transformer networks
items.title_zh: 基于超声图像的日本血吸虫相关肝纤维化深度学习分级：卷积网络与Transformer网络的加权软投票集成
items.abstract_en: Background: Schistosomiasis morbidity still persists in China despite extensive progress towards elimination of new and active infections. Diagnosis of liver fibrosis related to Schistosoma japonicum remains challenging due to the subjective nature of ultrasound grading and the shortage of experienced sonographers in endemic counties. Methods: We developed a deep learning model that grades schistosomal liver fibrosis from a single B-mode ultrasound image without manual delineation of a region of interest. We used 2,921 images from 2,921 adults (aged 18-88 years, median age 54 years; 46.4% female) from a schistosomiasis hospital in Jiangxi Province, China, between 2019 and 2023. Of these, 12.9%, 34.6%, 32.4% and 20.2% had grade 0, 1, 2 and 3 fibrosis, respectively. Fibrosis grades were based on the clinical ultrasound record and re-evaluation by an experienced radiologist according to the Chinese Handbook of Schistosomiasis Control; discordant cases were reviewed by a second radiologist and resolved by consensus. Predictions from four neural networks with different architectures (ResNet-18, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet-121 and Swin-T) were combined by weighted soft voting, with weights derived from validation performance. Results: For the four-grade task this model achieved a macro-F1 of 0.8527 (95% CI 0.8184-0.8856), an accuracy of 0.8500 (0.8136-0.8818) and a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.9187 (0.8983-0.9373) on a fixed test set of 440 images. For detecting significant fibrosis (grade 2 or 3; test-set prevalence 0.530), sensitivity was 0.9700, specificity was 0.9179, positive predictive value was 0.9300, negative predictive value was 0.9645, and AUROC was 0.9817. The ensemble achieved a higher macro-F1 than each individual backbone. Every ensemble misclassification was to an adjacent grade; no image with severe fibrosis was classified as no or mild fibrosis, or vice versa, whereas each individual backbone made 1-4 errors spanning two or more grades. Conclusions: The model may provide an automated aid for Schistosoma japonicum-associated fibrosis grading and could potentially support screening and follow-up in endemic areas after external validation.

items.title_en: Incremental value of bilateral ankle-brachial index for ten-year heart and cerebrovascular mortality prediction: an exploratory temporal benchmark in NHANES
items.title_zh: 双侧踝臂指数对十年心脑血管死亡预测的增量价值：NHANES中的探索性时间基准
items.abstract_en: Background: Ankle-brachial index (ABI) is associated with systemic vascular disease, but its incremental predictive value depends on the clinical comparator, endpoint and validation design. Objective: To test whether a bilateral ABI feature block improves a nonlaboratory clinical benchmark for ten-year death from diseases of the heart or cerebrovascular disease, and whether a limited nonlinear learner improves the same chronological evaluation. Methods: We rebuilt public NHANES 1999-2004 examination data linked to the 2019 public-use mortality file. Adults aged at least 40 years with bilateral ABI values in [0.20, 2.50] and ascertainable 120-month status formed a survey-weighted analytic subset. Models were trained on 1999-2002, tuned within development cycles, and evaluated on 2003-2004. Primary models were linear clinical logistic regression, flexible clinical logistic regression, flexible clinical plus ABI regression, and histogram gradient boosting plus ABI. Point estimates used full evaluation weights; conditional intervals used 32-replicate Fay balanced repeated replication with 15 design degrees of freedom. The study was not prospectively registered. Results: The corrected cohort contained 6,807 participants (4,617 development; 2,190 temporal evaluation) and 409 primary events, including 139 in evaluation. Evaluation AUROC was 0.834 for flexible clinical regression and 0.834 after ABI addition. The paired ABI increment was -0.0007 (95% CI -0.0047 to 0.0032); the paired Brier difference was 0.0008 (95% CI -0.0003 to 0.0018). Boosting plus ABI had AUROC 0.822; versus regression with the same predictor block, its AUROC difference was -0.0117 (95% CI -0.0379 to 0.0144). Its Brier difference was -0.000661 (95% CI -0.001322 to -7.53e-08); the upper limit was extremely close to zero. Neither primary hypothesis of improvement in both metrics was supported. Conclusions: In this corrective, exploratory chronological benchmark, bilateral ABI did not improve discrimination or Brier score beyond a matched flexible clinical model. The result does not negate ABI associations, establish equivalence, or support treatment decisions. It supports transparent evaluation of incremental information in a new cohort rather than claims of clinical utility.

items.title_en: Twenty-Hour Hypothermic Oxygenated Perfusion Preserves Myocardial Viability and Bioenergetics with No Primary Graft Dysfunction After Porcine Heart Transplantation
items.title_zh: 二十小时低温氧合灌注可维持猪心脏移植后心肌活力和生物能量学，且无原发性移植物功能障碍
items.abstract_en: Background: Hypothermic oxygenated perfusion (HOPE) may extend donor heart preservation beyond conventional storage durations. We evaluated early graft function and myocardial cellular and metabolic integrity following porcine heart transplantation after 20 hours of HOPE. Methods: Ten donor hearts underwent various preservation conditions: static cold storage (SCS) for 4 hours (n=2), HOPE for 4 hours (n=3), and HOPE for 20 hours (n=5), followed by heart transplantation (HT) in recipient pigs. Graft function was monitored over 3 hours by serial echocardiography, invasive hemodynamics, optical flow analysis, and vasoactive support scoring; myocardial tissue was analyzed by histopathology, flow cytometry, mitochondrial respirometry, transcriptomics, and proteomics. Results: Ejection fraction, right atrial pressure and systolic blood pressure did not differ between groups, and no graft met criteria for primary graft dysfunction. LV contractility was within normal range with comparable vasoactive support among all groups. Preservation-associated weight gain was greatest after HOPE 20h, and histopathology showed comparable findings with edema present in all cohorts, without fibrosis, thrombosis, or necrosis. Cardiomyocyte viability was preserved across all groups. Maximal oxygen consumption rate was elevated in HOPE 20h versus HOPE 4h and SCS 4h, while basal and non-mitochondrial respiration were similar. Transcriptomics and proteomics revealed limited differences in gene and pathway expression among groups. Conclusions: HOPE preserves donor heart viability, mitochondrial integrity, and ventricular function after 20 hours of preservation, without evidence of primary graft dysfunction, supporting extended preservation for heart transplantation. Edema, recovery of function, and metabolic responses warrant further investigation with longer-term monitoring.

items.title_en: Differences in sepsis from skin and soft tissue infections among patients with vs. without mental health disorders
items.title_zh: 伴有与不伴有精神健康障碍患者之间皮肤和软组织感染所致脓毒症的差异
items.abstract_en: Introduction Sepsis is a severe health condition that requires rapid and attentive treatment. The rise in sepsis cases reveals a lack of immediate supportive care in the healthcare system. This lapse may be attributed to a delay in sepsis recognition, patient incompatibility with care plan, and conditions that make treatment more difficult. Building on previous research, this paper seeks to explore the correlation between patients with mental health conditions and sepsis development. State how we define quality of sepsis care. Method Data from 2018-2019 from our ED sepsis quality database was analyzed using T-tests, comparing the characteristics, conditions, and quality of sepsis care of dermatologically-septic patients with and without mental health conditions. Results Between January 1, 2018 and December 31, 2019, 584 LIJ ED patients had sepsis that met inclusion criteria for quality review. Of these, 57 (9.8%) had sepsis of dermatologic origin, of which 30 (52.6%) were female (p = 0.4318). The source of sepsis was the lower extremity in 36.8% of mental health patients vs. 68.4% of non-mental health patients (p = 0.045) and sacral decubitus ulcer in 36.8% of mental health patients vs. 5.3% of non-mental health patients (p = 0.004). In neither univariate nor multivariate analysis were there statistically-significant differences in outcomes in patients with vs. without a mental health issue. However, the need for mechanical ventilation trended lower among patients with mental health disorder (p = 0.141) while the outcome of 3-hour bundle met trended higher among that same group (p = 0.11). Discussion Compared to patients with mental health issues, those without mental health issues had higher rates of sepsis due to lower extremity infections and sacral decubitus ulcer infections. None of the outcome variables met statistical significance. However, dermatologic sepsis patients without mental health issues tended to be more sick than those with mental health issues, as gauged by rates of septic shock and ICU admission (both trending toward statistical significance). They also trended toward receiving lower quality care, as measured by adherence with the 3-hour sepsis bundle. Failure to achieve statistical significance might be due to the small sample size. This is likely the case, as, for example, there was a substantial difference in the percent of multi-racial patients between those with (5.3%) vs. without (28.9%) mental health illness, yet even this large difference did not meet statistical significance (p = 0.104).

items.title_en: The role of climate and immunity in Brazil unprecedented outbreak of dengue in 2024
items.title_zh: 气候与免疫在2024年巴西登革热空前暴发中的作用
items.abstract_en: Brazil experienced a large dengue epidemic during the 2024 season, with almost 5.7 million total cases (compared to under 1.3 million in 2023), raising questions about underlying drivers, including rising temperatures, expansion into susceptible populations, changes in reporting, and novel strains. We compared state-level 2024 incidence with 2000 - 2023 data to quantify anomalies. Nine of 27 states, primarily in the Southeast, recorded their highest incidence in 25 years, accounting for 97% of cases while comprising only 67% of the population. In contrast, nine states (mostly in the North and Northeast) reported below-average incidence. Counterintuitively, the correlation between state-level temperature and incidence declined significantly over the study period, turning negative by 2024 (r = -0.72), a reversal from the positive correlations observed at the start. To determine whether this pattern was driven by northern temperatures being too high for transmission, or by spatial variation in immunity, we fit generalized additive models to effective reproductive numbers. Transmission remained substantial at the highest temperatures, while reproductive numbers declined with lagged cumulative incidences, indicating susceptibility depletion was important. We then estimated state-level susceptibility using a mechanistic SEIR-SEI model, describing a trade-off: high temperatures supported high transmission rates, but were associated with reduced susceptibility. Linear regression models confirmed both temperature and susceptibility were necessary to predict the 2024 outbreaks, suggesting that immunity plays an important role in modulating temperature's effect on incidence. Future surveillance integrating measures of immunity could enhance forecasts and early-warning systems, particularly as climate change expands dengue into immunologically naive populations.

items.title_en: Allostatic load as a potential pathway linking exposomic risk to early-onset cancer: a matched case-control study in the All of Us Research Program
items.title_zh: 稳态负荷作为连接暴露组风险与早发性癌症的潜在通路：All of Us研究项目中的匹配病例对照研究
items.abstract_en: Background: Early-onset cancer (EoC) incidence is rising worldwide, yet risk models built on isolated exposures or rare pathogenic variants capture little of the cumulative environmental burden experienced by younger adults. Allostatic load (AL), the cumulative physiological burden of chronic stress, can be measured from routine laboratory values and vital signs and is a candidate biological pathway linking environmental exposures to carcinogenesis. Methods: We conducted a 1:4 matched case-control study nested within the NIH All of Us Research Program, including 7,550 participants and 1,510 cancers diagnosed before age 50, of which 298 were exposome-related (the primary outcome). We derived an exposomic risk score (ERS) from 12 survey-based measures and an eight-component AL score from electronic health record data, and used mediation analysis to estimate the proportion of the ERS-EoC association operating through AL. Results: A higher ERS was associated with higher AL ({beta}=0.18 standard deviations [SD] per SD; 95% CI 0.16-0.20), and each SD increase in AL was associated with 21% higher odds of EoC (odds ratio 1.21; 95% CI 1.15-1.28). For exposome-related EoC, AL mediated 17.0% (95% CI 7.4-49.5%) of the association between the ERS and EoC, with significant total, direct, and indirect effects that were robust to lag, scoring, and age-adjustment sensitivity analyses. Across all EoC, the proportion mediated was 48.8% (95% CI 21.2-186.5%). Conclusions: AL is a candidate biomarker and potential pathway through which cumulative environmental burden relates to EoC, warranting prospective validation in independent cohorts.

items.title_en: Metformin use and the risk of incident breast cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis accounting for time-related biases, and why imeglimin cannot yet be evaluated
items.title_zh: 二甲双胍使用与新发乳腺癌风险：一项考虑时间相关偏倚的系统综述和荟萃分析，以及为何伊美格列明尚无法评估
items.abstract_en: Background: Observational studies have suggested that metformin lowers breast cancer risk, but many were susceptible to immortal time and time-window bias. Imeglimin, a structurally related glucose-lowering drug approved in Japan in 2021, has been proposed as a candidate for cancer prevention. Methods: We searched PubMed (1 November 2026) and the reference lists of earlier meta-analyses for cohort and case-control studies that reported breast cancer-specific estimates for metformin use and incident breast cancer. One report per source population was pooled with a DerSimonian-Laird random-effects model. Studies were classified by whether they addressed time-related biases, using a new-user design, time-varying exposure or target trial emulation. For imeglimin, we applied the same criteria in a systematic search of PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov, assessed whether a meta-analysis was feasible, and reviewed non-clinical and structural data. Results: The search identified 368 PubMed records and 28 reports from other sources. Twenty-two reports from 15 source populations were eligible, and 12 independent studies were pooled. The pooled relative risk (RR) was 0.89 (95% CI 0.74-1.07; I-squared = 90.5%). In nine studies that addressed time-related biases, the RR was 1.00 (0.94-1.08; I-squared = 0%). In three that did not, or were unclear, it was 0.69 (0.56-0.84); the between-group difference was Q = 12.78, p = 0.0004. The difference was not significant when the one unclear study was reclassified (Q = 1.15, p = 0.28). For imeglimin, the search returned 218 PubMed records and 10 registered studies, but no clinical study reported breast cancer or any cancer outcome. No meta-analysis was possible. The available evidence consisted of one in vitro study in breast cancer cells, one docking study, and models of other cancers at concentrations at least about 40-fold above clinical plasma levels. A comparative cohort would need about 631 breast cancer events to detect a hazard ratio of 0.80. Conclusions: In studies that addressed time-related biases, metformin use was not associated with incident breast cancer. A meta-analysis of imeglimin and breast cancer is not yet possible, because no clinical study exists and exposure time since approval is short. Its structural relation to metformin does not by itself predict a preventive effect. The next step should be an adequately powered new-user, active-comparator cohort study. Registration: PROSPERO CRD420261301586 (submitted 6 February 2026; registered 1 November 2026). Deviations from the protocol are reported in the Methods.

items.title_en: Delayed-centrifugation blood collection tube for remote blood biomarker assessment
items.title_zh: 用于远程血液生物标志物评估的延迟离心采血管
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) and amyloid-{beta} 42 (A{beta}42) are advancing toward clinical use for Alzheimer's disease (AD), but their reliability can be impacted by preanalytical handling. Although alternative collection tubes with distinct stabilization strategies --P100 (protease inhibitor) and HEMAcollect (hemolysis/platelet-activation minimization) --have been developed to stabilize plasma proteins, how well they preserve these markers remains unresolved; we therefore compared both against fresh standard EDTA tubes. Methods: In 40 participants, plasma p-tau217 and A{beta}42 were measured (Lumipulse) in paired fresh EDTA, P100, and HEMAcollect samples after 5-day ambient storage. We assessed concentration change, rank-order preservation (Spearman {rho}), percentage difference, and diagnostic classification under the p-tau217/A{beta}42 ratio and p-tau217 alone. Results: P100 preserved p-tau217 favorably, with high rank-order correlation ({rho}=0.98) and a modest median change (+12.1%), and its classification agreement with fresh EDTA reached 97.5% using p-tau217 alone. HEMAcollect showed greater p-tau217 signal loss (-57.5%). A{beta}42 was reduced in both tubes (-72.8% P100; -95.5% HEMAcollect) with loss of rank order, so neither preserved the p-tau217/A{beta}42 ratio. Discussion: Stability was tube- and analyte-specific, and P100 consistently outperformed HEMAcollect --preserving p-tau217 rank order while HEMAcollect reduced signal across analytes. Although neither tube preserved the A{beta}42-dependent ratio, P100 shows potential for p-tau217-based workflows. Preanalytical stability must be established analyte by analyte before alternative tubes enter clinical AD diagnosis.

items.title_en: Decision-Making Under Stress, Biological Stress Responses, and Risk for Suicidal Behavior in Young Adults
items.title_zh: 压力下的决策、生物应激反应与年轻人自杀行为风险
items.abstract_en: Background: Stress may influence decision-making processes relevant to suicidal behavior, yet few studies have examined risky decision-making and expected value (EV) sensitivity under stress longitudinally among young adults at elevated suicide risk. Methods: Participants included 233 young adults (18-30 years) with recent suicide attempts (n=55), suicidal ideation (n=59), psychiatric controls (n=71), and healthy controls (n=48). Hair cortisol concentration, circulating inflammatory markers (CRP, IL-6, IL-10, IL-1ra, TNF-alpha), Stressful Cups Task, and clinical measures were assessed at baseline, 3-, 6-, and 12-month follow-ups. Results: Participants with a history of suicide attempts showed greater reductions in risky choices under stress over time compared to healthy controls. Greater reductions in EV sensitivity under stress relative to neutral conditions predicted subsequent suicidal behavior. Higher C-reactive protein (CRP) was associated with fewer risky choices under both neutral and stress conditions, while higher interleukin-6 (IL-6) was associated with fewer risky choices under neutral conditions. Higher interleukin-10 (IL-10) was associated with greater reductions in risky choices under stress relative to neutral conditions over time. No significant associations were observed for hair cortisol concentrations (HCC). Conclusions: Stress-related changes in risky decision-making and reduced EV sensitivity may contribute to vulnerability to suicidal behavior. These findings highlight the importance of assessing decision-making under stress and examining inflammatory processes as potential mechanisms underlying suicide risk.

items.title_en: Therapeutic acute intermittent hypoxia alters supraspinal neural control of lower limb movement in multiple sclerosis
items.title_zh: 治疗性急性间歇性低氧改变多发性硬化症患者下肢运动的脊髓上神经控制
items.abstract_en: Acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) therapy is a promising neurorehabilitative intervention with well-documented enhancements in motor function in people with spinal cord injury. Its enhancements in lower-limb motor control in multiple sclerosis (MS), where walking impairment is a leading source of disability, remain uncharacterized, and the supraspinal effects of AIH therapy are unknown. In a sham-controlled, double-blind crossover trial (NCT05164705), 23 adults with MS completed 5 sessions of AIH therapy and of sham therapy; magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was performed before and after each therapeutic arm. At each timepoint, blood oxygenation level-dependent (BOLD) functional MRI was collected during a repeated plantar- and dorsi-flexion task. Task-evoked activation was modeled at the group level and compared across timepoint and therapeutic arm. Activation changes differed for the left- and right-foot task. AIH augmented activation in the basal ganglia, thalamus, and cortical motor regions during left-foot movement with similar but sub-threshold patterns for the right foot. Right-foot movement additionally showed enhanced deactivation in prefrontal, parietal, and temporal cortices, although these effects were primarily in white matter voxels, limiting their interpretability. These findings suggest that changes in subcortical activation may contribute to motor function improvements following AIH therapy, implicating the basal ganglia-thalamo-cortical motor loop as a target of AIH-induced neuroplasticity. These results also indicate that AIH therapy modulates supraspinal motor circuitry, supporting further investigation of the cortical and subcortical effects of this emerging therapeutic treatment.

items.title_en: Time of Day Dependent Effectiveness of Anti-IgE Therapy in Asthma: Clinical and Experimental Evidence
items.title_zh: 抗IgE治疗哮喘疗效的时间依赖性：临床与实验证据
items.abstract_en: Background: Asthma is a time-sensitive inflammatory disease whose activity exhibits daily (circadian) rhythms. An outstanding question is whether such temporal variations extend to advanced asthma treatments like biologics that are used for moderate-to-severe disease. Objective: To examine how time-of-administration relates to the effectiveness of the anti-IgE biologic, omalizumab. Methods: We performed a retrospective cohort study of omalizumab effectiveness in 153 patients with asthma with timestamped administration records. Time of day was modeled as a continuous variable and dichotomized into morning (8:00-11:59, n=74) versus afternoon (12:00-17:00, n=79) administration. Multivariable logistic regression and Cox time-to-event analyses were used to adjust for key covariates. For biological validation, we treated ovalbumin (OVA)-sensitized mice with anti-IgE antibody at various times of day and measured its impact on inflammatory lung pathology. Results: Receiving the initial dose of omalizumab in the afternoon was associated with better response, defined as a 50% or more reduction in asthma exacerbations in the year after initiation (Odds ratio, OR: 5.20; 95% CI, 1.94-13.96). For each hour later in the day the initial dose of omalizumab was given, the odds of a response increased by 34% (adjusted OR, 1.34; 1.02-1.77). In OVA-sensitized mice, anti-IgE treatment attenuated inflammatory lung pathology, including OVA-induced airway hyperresponsiveness and type-2 inflammation-related gene expression, in a time-of-day-sensitive manner, with maximum effectiveness when dosed in the latter part of the dark phase, functionally analogous to the afternoon in humans. Conclusion: The timing of anti-IgE treatment for asthma may influence therapeutic success. These findings have implications for optimizing the effectiveness of respiratory biologics.

items.title_en: Short intervals of inertial measurement unit data collected during activities of daily living can provide a quantitative method to assess disease severity and functional ability in Parkinson's disease
items.title_zh: 日常生活活动中采集的短时段惯性测量单元数据可提供评估帕金森病疾病严重程度和功能能力的定量方法
items.abstract_en: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder affecting roughly one million people in the U.S. People with PD (PwPD) exhibit classic motor symptoms that limit performance on functional tasks and reduce quality of life (QOL). Despite functional ability (FA) being a critical indicator of patient well-being, objective and quantitative measurement of FA during activities of daily living (ADLs) is not a part of standard clinical assessments. To address this gap, we conducted a pilot study of PwPD (n = 39) and healthy controls (n = 7) performing ADLs. We attached nine-axis inertial measurement units (IMUs) to toothbrushes and hair combs to collect continuous acceleration and angular velocity data during toothbrushing and hair-combing tasks. After preprocessing, we visualized signals with kernel density estimation and continuous wavelet transforms, revealing characteristic distributional, temporal, and spectral patterns. We then segmented signals into 3-9 second non-overlapping intervals. From each interval, we extracted 30 features (13 acceleration-derived, 17 angular-velocity-derived) and trained eXtreme Gradient Boosted (XGBoost) classifiers to discriminate disease state and severity, symptom presence, and impaired FA. Notably, models trained on hair-combing data discriminated PwPD from controls (balanced accuracy 0.864) and identified patient-reported impairment in FA (0.869). Models trained on toothbrushing data achieved moderate performance on the same tasks (balanced accuracy 0.752 and 0.686, respectively). These preliminary findings suggest that short-segment IMU data from common ADL implements can quantitatively characterize disease severity and task-specific performance in PwPD, supporting their integration into routine clinical care.

items.title_en: Alzheimers disease and psychiatric polygenic risk are disease-specific and independent of plasma biomarkers in a real-world young-onset dementia cohort.
items.title_zh: 在真实世界年轻起病痴呆队列中，阿尔茨海默病和精神疾病多基因风险具有疾病特异性且独立于血浆生物标志物
items.abstract_en: Background: Young onset dementia is frequently misdiagnosed, particularly where neurodegenerative and primary psychiatric disorders (PPD) overlap. Plasma biomarkers measure current pathology, whereas polygenic risk scores (PRS) capture lifelong genetic risk. Whether PRS derived from late-onset and population samples transfer to young-onset presentations, and how they relate to plasma biomarkers, is unknown. Methods: We studied 687 participants of European ancestry from the Markers in Neuropsychiatric Disorders (MiND) Study, a prospective young-onset neuropsychiatry cohort: 195 healthy controls (HC), 283 PPD, 55 Alzheimers disease (AD) and 154 non-AD neurodegenerative disease (oNDG). PRS for AD, a cross-disorder psychiatric factor (PSY), frontotemporal dementia, Lewy body dementia and Parkinsons disease were computed with PRS CS, excluding the APOE locus. Plasma NfL, GFAP and p-tau217 were available for 332 participants. Models were adjusted for age, sex and APOE e4 dose. Results: Relative to HC, the AD PRS was associated with AD (OR 1.69 per SD, 95% CI 1.17-2.45) but not PPD (0.95, 0.77-1.16). The PSY PRS showed the reciprocal pattern (PPD 1.29, 1.05-1.58; AD 1.00, 0.72-1.40). No PRS was associated with any plasma protein. In distinguishing PPD from oNDG, NfL was the strongest discriminator (OR 2.15, 1.62-2.83). The AD PRS was also associated with oNDG (1.38, 1.11-1.71), without improving discrimination (AUC 0.764 for NfL alone versus 0.773 combined). Conclusion: In young onset presentations, AD and psychiatric polygenic risk are disease-specific and independent of plasma biomarkers of neurodegeneration. Their combined diagnostic value requires evaluation in larger, longitudinal pre-clinical cohorts.

items.title_en: Benchmarking single-subject detectability of cognitive event-related potentials in healthy controls and minimally conscious state patients
items.title_zh: 健康对照者与最小意识状态患者中认知事件相关电位单受试者可检测性的基准评估
items.abstract_en: Event-related potentials (ERP) may reveal residual cognitive processing in disorders of consciousness, but clinical translation is limited because group-level effects do not guarantee reliable single-subject detection. Few ERP paradigms have been benchmarked in healthy participants and compared directly with patients in disorders of consciousness. We tested a hierarchical ERP battery in healthy controls and patients in minimally conscious state (MCS) to (1) estimate upper-bound single-subject detectability in healthy participants, (2) compare detection rates with those of MCS patients, and (3) evaluate prognostic value for recovery of consciousness. Forty-eight healthy controls and 26 patients in MCS completed six auditory paradigms: multifeature mismatch negativity (MMN), passive and active oddball P300, the subject's own name, semantic oddball, and sentence N400. Effects were classified using blinded expert visual scoring, region-of-interest ANOVA, cluster-based permutation tests, and support vector machine decoding. Associations between binary ERP classifications and recovery were tested in 22 surviving patients at follow-up. In healthy controls, visual scoring identified MMN to at least one deviant and P300 in both oddball tasks in all 48 participants. Command following as demonstrated by task-related P300 enhancement between active and passive oddball conditions was detected in 81%. Command following was detected in 92% in the semantic oddball task. Sentence-congruity effects (N400 and/or P600) were identified in 69%, despite a strong group-level response, while the own-name effect was detected in only 35%. In patients, detection rates were lower: MMN was found in 27% for the short-duration deviant and 65% when any of five deviant types counted as positive; passive oddball P300 in 35% and active oddball P300 in 31%; sentence-congruity effects in 12%; active-versus-passive oddball modulation in 12%; and semantic oddball effects in 8%. Visual scoring and machine learning generally detected more effects than ANOVA and cluster-based testing, and agreement varied substantially across paradigms. Binary ERP classifications were not significantly associated with recovery (14 recovered, eight did not), although prognostic analyses were limited by sample size. Group-level ERP effects overstated single-subject detectability in healthy controls, whereas the absence of group-level effects in MCS obscured reliable ERP responses resembling those of healthy controls in a few individual patients. In MCS, ERP effects associated with semantic processing and command following were generally uncommon, and binary ERP indicators did not predict recovery in this sample. Our findings establish a benchmark for selecting and refining ERP paradigms and detection methods to assess residual cognition after severe brain injury.

items.title_en: Placental Klotho responses to supervised prenatal exercise: findings from the PLACENTRAINING study
items.title_zh: 胎盘Klotho对监督性产前运动的反应：PLACENTRAINING研究结果
items.abstract_en: Background: Regular exercise during pregnancy improves maternal and neonatal outcomes; however, the molecular pathways underlying placental adaptations to prenatal exercise remain poorly understood. Klotho is a cytoprotective protein involved in the regulation of oxidative stress, metabolic homeostasis, and cellular resilience, yet whether placental Klotho concentrations are associated with prenatal exercise has not been previously investigated. Aims: The primary aim of this study was to examine whether participation in a supervised concurrent exercise program during pregnancy is associated with placental Klotho concentrations at birth. Secondary aims were to explore potential fetal sex-specific patterns and associations between placental Klotho and selected biomarkers related to angiogenic and inflammatory pathways. Methods: Pregnant women were allocated to either a supervised concurrent exercise program or usual care. The intervention comprised combined aerobic and resistance training performed three times per week from early-mid pregnancy until birth. Placental tissue was collected at birth, and Klotho concentrations were quantified by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Secondary analyses explored potential sex-specific patterns and examined associations between placental Klotho, placental weight, and a panel of placental biomarkers. Results: Seventy-six women were included (exercise: n = 41; control: n = 35). Placental Klotho concentrations were significantly higher in the exercise group, with an adjusted mean difference of approximately 101 pg/mL (p = 0.001; partial 2= 0.164). This effect was consistent across fetal sex, with no significant exercise-by-sex interaction. Several placental biomarkers were independently associated with Klotho, suggesting a potential relationship with angiogenic and inflammatory signaling pathways. Conclusions: Participation in a supervised concurrent exercise program during pregnancy is associated with higher placental Klotho concentrations at birth, irrespective of fetal sex. These findings provide novel insight into molecular pathways potentially involved in placental adaptations associated with prenatal exercise and reinforce the concept of the placenta as an exercise-responsive organ during pregnancy. Keywords: Concurrent training; Exerkines; Oxidative stress; Pregnancy; Placental function

items.title_en: Lymphocyte Stability Following Immune Checkpoint Blockade Is Coupled to Mitochondrial Haplogroup and Clinical Outcome in Advanced Melanoma
items.abstract_en: Early biomarkers of durable response to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) are urgently needed. We identify lymphocyte stability (LS) - preservation of peripheral lymphocyte counts after one cycle of ICB - as an on-treatment predictor of overall survival (OS) in metastatic melanoma (MM): patients with unstable lymphocyte counts (LS-U; post-ICB/baseline [≤]0.8) have markedly increased risk of death. Metabolic profiling of patient T cells demonstrates ICB enhancement of mitochondrial bioenergetics, whilst CD8+ T cells from LS-U patients mount an exaggerated transcriptional response to ICB incorporating upregulation of mitochondrial pathways. Given these findings we assessed the relationship of LS with mitochondrial haplogroup, revealing carriage of haplogroup T (HG-T), present in ~10% of white British individuals, is associated with both LS-U and impaired OS, with mediation analysis implicating LS mediation. HG-T carriers have higher CD8+ T-cell pre-treatment mitochondrially encoded transcript abundance and, in paired scRNA-seq data, fewer progenitor-exhausted cells, ICB hyperresponsivity, apoptotic program induction and reduced clonal persistence, consistent with baseline mitochondrial priming. These findings position LS as a clinically accessible marker of ICB outcome linked to inherited mitochondrial variation.

items.title_en: Extending an Established Speech Recognition Threshold Procedure for Use in Noise: An Exploratory Study.
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Purpose: This exploratory study examined whether an established clinical procedure for determining speech recognition thresholds in quiet, as outlined by the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (1988), could be extended to a competing-noise condition using existing recorded speech materials. The objectives were to determine whether the resulting speech recognition thresholds in noise (SRTinNs) were broadly consistent with findings from established speech-in-noise measures and to examine their associations with pure-tone thresholds. Methods: Twenty-five adults participated in this exploratory study: 15 with sensorineural hearing loss and 10 with normal audiograms. SRTinNs were estimated using an adaptation of the established threshold-seeking procedure with Canadian French monosyllabic words presented against continuous eight-talker babble. SRTinNs were compared between groups, and associations with pure-tone averages were examined among participants with hearing loss. Results: Mean SRTinNs were +7.2 dB signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for participants with hearing loss and +1.7 dB SNR for those with normal audiograms, representing a significant difference of 5.5 dB SNR (p = .02). Among participants with hearing loss, SRTinNs were significantly correlated with conventional pure-tone averages (r = .54, p = .04) and high-frequency pure-tone averages (r = .64, p = .01). Conclusions: The findings provide preliminary support for further investigation of extending an established clinical threshold-seeking procedure to competing-noise conditions. Further investigation of this approach may help expand access to speech-in-noise assessment in linguistic contexts where suitable recorded speech materials are available but dedicated speech-in-noise tests are lacking.

items.title_en: Defining influenza epidemic zones through temporal clustering of global surveillance data
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Modeling when influenza epidemics typically occur can help countries optimize surveillance, time clinical and public health interventions, and reduce the burden of influenza. Methods: We used influenza virus detections reported during 2011-2024 by 180 countries to the Global Influenza Surveillance and Response System, excluding years impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic (2020-2023). We analyzed data by calendar year (week 1-52) or shifted year (week 30-29) time windows, based on when most influenza detections occurred in each country. For countries with sufficient data, we computed generalized additive models (GAMs) of each country's weekly influenza-positive tests to smooth and impute time series distributions. From these GAMs, we calculated each country's weekly influenza burden. Country-specific time series were grouped using ensemble consensus k-means clustering, reducing the Euclidean distance between time series within clusters. We calculated cluster-specific GAMs to estimate average seasonal timing. Countries without sufficient data were assigned to a cluster based on population-weighted latitudinal distance to a cluster's mean latitude. Results: We identified five clusters, or epidemic zones, from 111 countries with sufficient data. The influenza burden in epidemic zones A and B was consistent with a northern hemisphere pattern, with most influenza detections occurring during November-May, while epidemic zones D and E were characterized by southern hemisphere-like seasonal timing, with most influenza burden occurring during June-November (D) and May-November (E). Epidemic zone C had most influenza burden occurring during September-March ; most countries assigned to this cluster were in the tropics. Conclusion: Epidemic zones may serve as a useful tool to strengthen and optimize influenza surveillance for global health decision-making (e.g., during vaccine strain composition discussions) and to guide country preparedness efforts for seasonal influenza epidemics, including timing enhanced surveillance and informing the availability of prevention and control efforts.

items.title_en: Remodeling of α1-Acid Glycoprotein Glycoforms During Long-Term Calorie Restriction
items.abstract_en: AGP1 (-1 acid glycoprotein) is an acute phase immune response protein recently shown to influence leptin receptor activity and body weight regulation. AGP is a highly glycosylated protein, with 45% of its molecular weight made up by glycans, yet little is known about how the latter responds to metabolic interventions or its role in AGPs immunometabolic function. In this pilot study (n = 26), we evaluated the effect of calorie restriction (CR - 2years, 25% CR in non-obese adults) on N-glycosylation of AGP1. AGP1 has 5 glycosylation sites, of which sites IV and V are dominated by highly branched, fucosylated, and sialylated glycans, and inflammatory conditions are associated with reduced branching at sites IV and V and increased fucosylation. With CR (0 month to 24 month, ~12% CR, weight loss of ~8.2 kg), there was increase in branching at sites IV and V (p<0.05, FDR corrected), and increased fucosylation (p<0.05, FDR corrected). Exploratory moderation analyses suggest that highly sialylated site IV glycans and low-branched site I glycans may influence the relationship between CR and leptin (p<0.05). Overall, AGP glycome is largely remodeled with CR, and it is unknown if these are upstream or downstream of immunometabolic changes seen with CR.

items.title_en: A Spatially Validated Machine-Learning Framework for Mapping Alpha-Gal Syndrome Exposure Potential in Illinois
items.abstract_en: The lone star tick, Amblyomma americanum, is closely associated with alpha-gal syndrome (AGS), an emerging tick-associated allergic condition. However, heterogeneous tick surveillance and limited clinical AGS data complicate the assessment of geographic exposure. We investigated whether ecological modeling and epidemiological surveillance could identify areas of potentially elevated AGS exposure across Illinois. Using data from 102 Illinois counties, eight statistical and machine-learning models were evaluated through geographic cross-validation to predict the relative abundance of lone star ticks. Random forest and XGBoost predictions were separately combined with reported ehrlichiosis rates to construct county-level AGS exposure-risk indices. Wildland-urban interface (WUI) population was examined in sensitivity analyses. Random forest achieved near-minimum prediction error while XGBoost demonstrated the strongest rank correlation. Both indices showed substantial concordance with CDC suspected-AGS categories across 97 counties (Spearman {rho} = 0.710 and 0.721). At the highest category threshold, odds ratios per 0.10-unit index increase were 5.02 and 3.63, respectively. By integrating ecological predictions with epidemiological surveillance, we establish a reproducible, spatially explicit framework for prioritizing AGS surveillance, targeting interventions, and guiding future epidemiological investigations across Illinois counties.

items.title_en: Physiological Trajectories and Observation Patterns in ICU Mortality Prediction: Transportability Under Changing Measurement Conditions
items.abstract_en: Objective: To distinguish the transferable predictive value of physiological trajectories from that of observation patterns in ICU mortality prediction, and to assess whether measurement timing affects performance independently of observation quantity. Materials and Methods: In-hospital mortality was predicted at 48 hours using MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU. Nested representations progressively integrated latest-value snapshots (R1), longitudinal physiological summaries (R2), and measurement frequency and timing features (R3). Models fitted on 7,762 MetaVision patients were evaluated on 21,682 MIMIC-IV patients and 43,878 eICU patients across 204 hospitals. The effect of measurement timing was assessed while holding the number of retained observations constant. Results: Physiological trajectories improved external prediction in eICU (R2-R1 log-loss difference -0.00922, 95% CI -0.01148 to -0.00704). Observation-pattern features improved locally developed eICU models (R3-R2 -0.00257, 95% CI -0.00370 to -0.00146), but not clearly after transfer from MetaVision (-0.00012, 95% CI -0.00206 to +0.00208). R3 was favoured in 10 of 30 source bootstrap refits. At matched observation counts, retaining measurements spread throughout the window reduced log loss relative to random retention by 0.03280 for R3 versus 0.00703 for R2. Removing the final 12 hours increased log loss relative to count-matched random removal by 0.01947 for R3 versus 0.00822 for R2. Under reduced availability, the local R3 increment changed from beneficial to harmful. Discussion: Physiological trajectories transferred more consistently, while observation-pattern features were particularly sensitive to the timing and availability of measurements. Conclusion: Clinical prediction models should be evaluated not only in new patient populations but also under the measurement conditions that supply their inputs.

items.title_en: A richness-sensitive Acoustic Biodiversity Index from species-level detections: classifier benchmarking, false-positive control and validation against standard soundscape indices in an African savanna and an urban zoo
items.title_zh: 一种基于物种级检测的丰富度敏感声学生物多样性指数：分类器基准测试、假阳性控制，以及在非洲稀树草原和城市动物园中对照标准声景指数的验证
items.abstract_en: Acoustic indices are widely used as rapid proxies for biodiversity, but they summarise the distribution of sound energy rather than the species producing it and often track richness poorly. We revise and test an Acoustic Biodiversity Index (ABI) built from species-level detections. Its primary form, ABI_E, is Shannon diversity of detections normalised by the regional species pool expected at the site and season (H / ln S_ref); temporal stability T is reported as a separate component. We first benchmarked four classifiers on a strongly labelled tropical dataset (1,216 calls, 24 classes) with recording-grouped cross-validation. BirdNET embeddings + logistic regression performed best (macro-F1 0.750 +/- 0.029), and random frame-level splits inflated accuracy from 0.41 to 0.70. We then applied BirdNET v2.4 with a location and season filter to recordings from a riverine savanna in the Zambezi Valley, Zimbabwe, and from three habitats at Emirates Park Zoo and Resort, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. A stricter post-hoc location filter removed 517 high-confidence detections of 9 implausible species, all at the zoo. After diel-matched rarefaction to equal effort (6 h), the savanna site held 21 species (Hill number 1D = 9.83; ABI_E = 0.38) against 1.3-13 species (ABI_E = 0.03-0.21) at the zoo sites. Across 149 recorded hours, ABI_E correlated strongly with richness (Spearman rho = 0.93), whereas six standard indices did not (best: ACI, rho = 0.48). The stability term was lower at the savanna site (0.39) than at the zoo (0.65-0.67), showing that it penalises the natural diel cycle of bird activity. Species-level indices with explicit false-positive control, a declared regional reference pool and effort standardisation provide a more interpretable biodiversity indicator than energy-based acoustic indices.

items.title_en: A two-stage diffusion-driven morphogenesis model with evolving connectivity
items.abstract_en: Morphogenesis of diatom silica shells involves a sequence of topological transitions: initially separate ribs grow and branch, then merge through bridges, leaving a regular network of pores. Existing models based on diffusion-limited aggregation or reaction-diffusion reproduce either branching or pore formation, but not both within a single framework. Here we propose a two-stage model of diffusion-driven morphogenesis with evolving connectivity. The model is formulated on a fixed finite element mesh with a density field on an active layer. Stage 1 reproduces dendritic growth, where a stimulus based on the local diffusive flux exceeds a threshold. Stage 2 uses an inverted stimulus, where high local flux suppresses precipitation, stabilizing pores between the dendrites. The update rules are analogous to sensitivity in density-based topology optimization and to strain energy density in bone remodeling. The model predicts distinct morphological regimes on each stage, controlled by the respective thresholds. For a reference calculation, the predicted pore network is regular, with approximately uniform spacing, and pores are absent near the domain edges, consistent with observations on diatom valves. The model provides a unified framework for describing both stages of silica morphogenesis and suggests a route for comparing computational predictions with cryo-electron tomography data.

items.title_en: Locality-Controlled Out-of-Distribution Guidance for Robust Regulatory DNA Sequence Design
items.title_zh: 面向鲁棒调控DNA序列设计的局部性受控分布外引导
items.abstract_en: Designing regulatory DNA sequences for targeted gene-expression control is an important challenge. Recent approaches frame this task as property-conditioned generation, where diffusion models trained on natural sequences are guided toward high predicted activity through reward-based fine-tuning or sampling-time guidance. We show that single-reward evaluation can obscure reward-hacking behavior. By decomposing evaluation into property, novelty, and plausibility, we identify an empirically underexplored region of the evaluation space in which all three objectives are satisfied, but no existing baseline succeeds. We postulate that this gap arises because prior methods treat guidance primarily as a matter of magnitude. In regulatory DNA, however, sequence grammar is spatially nonuniform: motif positions are sensitive to perturbation, while background regions allow more exploration. We therefore propose LOCOGEN by reformulating guidance as a problem of locality. LOCOGEN learns an invariant motif mask through sequence-level invariance learning to protect motif positions, while applying OOD damping only to background positions. It operates at sampling time on a frozen diffusion backbone, without retraining the backbone. Across HepG2, K562, and SK-N-SH, LOCOGEN reaches this previously underexplored region of the property-novelty-plausibility space. Code is available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/LocoGen.

items.title_en: Hyperbolic embedding of higher-order simplicial networks
items.abstract_en: Many biological interactions involve groups rather than pairs, as when several proteins assemble into a multi-protein complex. Simplicial complexes naturally capture these collective interactions. Existing hyperbolic embeddings represent network hierarchy and similarity through a few interpretable coordinates, but rely only on pairwise links: they cannot distinguish three units engaged in a common interaction from three units connected only in pairs. We introduce here the hyperbolic higher-order (HHO) embedding, which embeds a simplicial complex into the Poincaré disk, while incorporating its group interactions. The hyperbolic area of the triangle spanned by three interacting nodes then measures how compactly their interaction is represented. Testson synthetic and real-world networks, including a co-authorship network and the protein interaction network of \textit{Escherichia coli}, show that HHO reduces the hyperbolic area of triangles representing simplices relative to those obtained from pairwise network embeddings. HHO also recovers node groups more accurately than pairwise embeddings and a weighted-clique alternative, with performance competitive with Euclidean embeddings, while providing a low-dimensional representation that can be analyzed with the tools of network geometry.

items.title_en: Co$^2$ODE: Conditionally Coarse-Grained Model Discovery for Rewiring in Biochemical Networks
items.title_zh: Co$^2$ODE：面向生化网络中重连的条件粗粒化模型发现
items.abstract_en: Biochemical networks propagate the signals that regulate cellular behaviour, and which routes carry them depends on cellular context: a shift in context rewires the network's effective dynamics. Mechanistic simulators are misspecified here because the effective dynamics emerge from an interaction structure that is only partially known. Model discovery instead learns the dynamics from data, but sparse, correlated measurements poorly identify a full network model. What matters is narrower: the portion the context rewires. We introduce conditionally coarse-grained ODEs (Co$^2$ODE), which model that portion as a sparse neural or symbolic ODE: a conditional mask selects the markers carrying the rewiring, and a variational autoencoder compresses the remaining markers into a learnt closure term. On single-cell phosphoproteomic data spanning 30 cancer-relevant overexpressions, Co$^2$ODE compresses a 30-marker panel into a 10-dimensional state while matching the predictive accuracy of a neural ODE fit to the full panel. The closure absorbs what the mask drops, hence the accuracy is insensitive to which markers are kept. Adding a prior score to the loss shifts the selected markers at no cost in fit, indicating the data are not interventional enough to identify the underlying biology.

items.title_en: Secret-shared teleportation of a two-qudit gate with a deferred recipient
items.title_zh: 含延迟接收方的双 qudit 门秘密共享隐形传态
items.abstract_en: An unknown quantum operation, like an unknown quantum state, cannot be perfectly copied or stored for later use. A specific gate can be embedded in an entangled resource and teleported, but its destination is fixed when the resource is created. Here we show that the capability to apply a two-qudit entangling gate can instead be secret-shared among many parties: the shares are distributed in advance, and a later key release lets exactly one of them, chosen after distribution, exercise it. A provider encrypts half of a Bell pair held with a user into $n$ shares, one per candidate node. The selected node, given the key qudits, completes an exact non-local $\mathtt{CSUM}^{k}$ gate with the user's data, in every measurement branch and for any qudit dimension, with the power $k$ chosen by the user alone. Any coalition of fewer than $n$ candidate nodes, or the key register alone, holds no information, unselected nodes cannot tell whether a selection occurred, and the key cannot decrypt twice. For two candidates the registers form a $((3,5))$ threshold scheme. Encoder and decoder are explicit $O(n)$ circuits. The construction supports jointly authorized and anonymous gate application, advancing distributed quantum computing and quantum network capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 未知的量子操作与未知量子态一样无法被完美复制或留待后用，特定门虽可嵌入纠缠资源并通过隐形传态实现，但其目标端在资源制备时即已固定。本文证明，施加双 qudit 纠缠门的能力可以在多方之间秘密共享：份额预先分发，日后的密钥释放使其中恰好在分发之后被选定的一个节点得以执行该门。提供方将与其用户共享的一半 Bell 对加密为 n 份份额，每个候选节点一份；被选中的节点获得密钥 qudit 后，即可与用户数据一起完成精确的非局域 CSUM^k 门，且在所有测量分支、任意 qudit 维度下均成立，幂次 k 仅由用户独自决定。任何少于 n 个候选节点的联盟，或仅持有密钥寄存器，都不掌握任何信息；未被选中的节点无法判断是否发生过选择，密钥也不能解密两次。两个候选节点时，各寄存器构成 ((3,5)) 阈值方案。编解码器均为显式 O(n) 电路。
items.highlight_zh: 纠缠门可预先秘密共享，密钥释放后才确定唯一执行方
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：量子态不能克隆，未知的量子操作也不能“存起来以后再用”。过去的做法是把某个特定的量子门嵌入纠缠资源中并隐形传态过去，但问题在于：资源一旦制备好，这个门最终落在哪个接收方就已经被写死了，无法事后再定。本文要问的是：能不能在还不知道谁会成为接收方的时候，就把“施加某个纠缠门的能力”分发出去？
方法：作者设计了一套“先分发、后选择”的协议。提供方与用户共享一对 Bell 纠缠对，把属于提供方的那一半加密拆成 n 份份额，每个候选节点拿到一份。日后若想指定某个节点来执行，只需释放密钥 qudit，被选中的节点就能与用户手中的数据共同完成一个精确的非局域 CSUM^k 门——关键在于，结论在所有测量分支下都成立，且对任意 qudit 维度都适用，指数 k 完全由用户自己选择，不必事先告诉任何候选节点。
结果：安全性方面，任何少于 n 个候选节点的联盟，或者仅拿到密钥寄存器本身，都得不到任何信息；未被选中的节点无法判断是否发生过选择；密钥也不能被使用两次。当候选节点为两个时，各寄存器正好构成一个 ((3,5)) 阈值方案。作者还给出了显式的编解码电路，复杂度为 O(n)，说明这件事在算法上是可高效操作的。
为何重要：它把“量子门隐形传态”从目标固定的静态资源变成可预先共享、按需激活的能力，并顺带支持联合授权与匿名施加门。这对分布式量子计算和量子网络很有意义——网络中可以有多个潜在节点，谁最终执行任务由事后的授权决定，而其他节点既不知情也无法干预。

items.title_en: Time-optimal quantum dynamics under fixed-norm generators
items.title_zh: 固定范数生成元下的时间最优量子动力学
items.abstract_en: We investigate the dynamics of quantum systems whose evolution is governed by linear generators of fixed unitarily invariant norm. For this broad class of evolutions, we derive a universal time-optimal generator of the dynamics converting one given state into another. It provides a time-optimal non-Hermitian Hamiltonian for pure state conversion. We then use this general result to derive quantum speed limits for mixed-state evolutions governed by Lindbladians and non-Hermitian Hamiltonians. Our findings follow from the geometric properties of the group $GL(n,\mathbb{C})$, in particular the geodesic distance. The derived bounds hold for an arbitrary system size $n$, depend only on the norms of the evolution generator and the initial and final states, and do not require performing any time-averaging.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究由固定酉不变范数的线性生成元所支配的量子系统动力学。针对这一大类演化，我们推导出将一个给定量子态转换为另一个给定量子态的普适时间最优生成元，它给出了纯态转换的时间最优非厄米哈密顿量。随后，我们利用这一一般性结果导出由 Lindblad 主方程和非厄米哈密顿量所支配的混合态演化的量子速度极限。这些结论源自 GL(n,ℂ) 群的几何性质，尤其是测地线距离。所得界限对任意系统维度 n 均成立，只依赖演化生成元的范数以及初末态的范数，且无需进行任何时间平均。
items.highlight_zh: 借助 GL(n,ℂ) 测地线距离，给出无需时间平均的量子速度极限
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：量子系统从初态演化到末态，最快需要多长时间？这类问题被称为量子速度极限（QSL）。以往结果常依赖具体的哈密顿量形式，需要做时间平均，且难以推广到混合态与开放系统。
方法：作者把演化生成元限定为数学上很宽的一类，即具有固定酉不变范数的线性生成元（例如固定范数的哈密顿量或非厄米矩阵）。在此框架下，作者利用 GL(n,ℂ) 复一般线性群的几何性质，特别是群上的测地线距离（即最短路径长度）来求最优解。
结果：(1) 给出了把一个给定态转换为另一个给定态的时间最优生成元；对纯态而言，它就是一个时间最优的非厄米哈密顿量；(2) 把结论推广到由 Lindblad 主方程和非厄米哈密顿量支配的混合态演化，得到相应的速度极限；(3) 这些界限对任意维度 n 都成立，只取决于生成元范数和初末态的范数，且完全不需时间平均。
意义：把“多快能到”这一实践问题归结为纯几何量；界限简洁，可直接由实验可测的范数估计，为量子控制、态制备与开放系统演化提供普适的速度上限。

items.title_en: Weighted hypergraph states as a resource for quantum metrology
items.title_zh: 加权超图态作为量子计量的资源
items.abstract_en: Quantum correlations can be used to improve sensing precision beyond classical limits, yet the correlated resource states needed can be challenging to prepare and preserve. Here, we study the family of weighted hypergraph states and identify subclasses characterized by their underlying graph topology that exhibit enhanced metrological performance. Using the quantum Fisher information and a novel Dicke state basis representation, we show that these subclasses outperform both separable and standard weighted graph state benchmarks over broad ranges of edge weights corresponding to weak controlled operations between qubits representing the vertices of the graph. We provide analytical formulas for an arbitrary number $N$ of qubits, supplemented by a general study, while focusing a detailed analysis on the example case of $N=4$. By identifying the critical probabilities for local dephasing, we show that adding higher-order weighted hyperedges for $N$ qubits can enhance metrological robustness, allowing the resulting states to retain a quantum advantage at higher noise levels. These probe states exhibit favorable scaling, enhanced precision, and noise tolerance. Our findings establish weighted hypergraph states as viable, structurally tunable and robust resources for quantum-enhanced metrology.
items.abstract_zh: 量子关联可用于把传感精度提升到超越经典极限，但所需的相关资源态往往难以制备与保存。本文研究加权超图态这一族量子态，并识别出若干可依据其底层图拓扑来刻画的、具有更强计量性能的子类。借助量子 Fisher 信息与一种新的 Dicke 态基表示，我们证明在与顶点间弱受控操作相对应的宽广边权范围内，这些子类优于可分离态与标准加权图态这两类基准。我们给出了任意 N 个量子比特的解析公式，并以 N=4 为例进行详细分析。通过确定局域退相干的临界概率，我们表明：为 N 量子比特引入高阶加权超边可增强计量鲁棒性，使所得态在更高噪声水平下仍保持量子优势。这些探针态具有良好可扩展性、更高精度与抗噪性。
items.highlight_zh: 加权超图态按拓扑分类，可同时提升精度与抗噪鲁棒性
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：量子计量利用纠缠等量子关联把测量精度推到经典极限之上，但“资源态”往往难制备、易被噪声破坏。作者考察一族结构灵活的多体态——加权超图态（普通图态的超边推广），并追问究竟哪些拓扑结构真正具有计量价值。
方法：以量子 Fisher 信息（QFI）作为精度标尺，并引入一种新的 Dicke 态基表示来解析计算 QFI；在弱受控操作（小边权）的广阔参数区间内，与可分离态和标准加权图态基准对比；对任意 N 个量子比特给出解析公式，并对 N=4 做详细数值分析；此外计算局域退相干的临界概率以评估抗噪能力。
结果：只有部分拓扑子类在 QFI 上占优，且优势集中在弱边权区域；为 N 量子比特加入高阶加权超边可抬高抗噪阈值，使态在更高噪声下仍保留量子优势；这些探针态在精度与可扩展性上表现良好。
意义：说明结构可调的加权超图态是实用、鲁棒的计量资源，并给出可按拓扑挑选资源态的设计思路。

items.title_en: Persistence of Unitary Almost Mathieu Operator Gaps Ten Dry Martinis, Five on the Rim
items.title_zh: 酉Almost Mathieu算子能隙的持续性：十杯干马天尼，五杯在杯沿
items.abstract_en: We determine exactly which gap labels are realized by open spectral gaps for the unitary almost Mathieu operator at every irrational frequency and all coupling constants ($0<λ_1,λ_2\leq1$). When both couplings are strictly less than one, every permitted gap label is realized by an open gap, including in the critical case ($λ_1=λ_2$). When at least one coupling equals one, both lifts of every odd winding label are realized by open gaps, whereas all even winding labels are collapsed. The proof combines quantitative almost reducibility and Aubry duality with a monotonicity principle for gap heights.

items.title_en: Functional Tensor Trains for High-Order Greeks and Exposure Tails of Multi-Asset Structured Products
items.title_zh: 用于多资产结构化产品高阶希腊值与敞口尾部的Functional Tensor Trains方法
items.abstract_en: Risk management of worst-of autocallables needs price sensitivities (Greeks) up to third order and the potential future exposure, a tail quantile of the note's future value. In Monte Carlo, each order of differentiation multiplies the sampling noise by a factor that grows with the observation frequency, and nested simulation turns the noise of its inner paths into a bias of the quantile. We instead solve the backward pricing recursion, storing the continuation value as an $hp$ functional tensor train (hp-FTT) whose piecewise-polynomial cores are split at the barriers, so that worst-of barrier events act exactly, with rank one. For Gaussian transitions we show that the polynomial degree sufficient for an error $\varepsilon$ grows only as $\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}$. One solve then gives every Greek at any spot without sampling noise, by integrating the likelihood-ratio weight against the stored value, and the values it stores at future dates replace inner simulation. Against the strongest Monte Carlo estimators we could build or find published, on worst-of autocallables observed monthly on three to five assets, the order of the Greek and the accuracy decide which method is cheaper. At $1\%$ accuracy Monte Carlo is more than an order of magnitude cheaper for deltas, second-order Greeks go either way, and hp-FTT is cheaper for every third-order Greek, by up to two orders of magnitude. At $0.1\%$ hp-FTT is cheaper for every Greek we could check, under geometric Brownian motion and local volatility alike. For the exposure alone Monte Carlo is cheaper at $1\%$ and hp-FTT at $0.1\%$, and a solve run for the Greeks yields it for little more than scenario sampling. Sampling pays in variance for each derivative and hp-FTT in rank for each asset, so Monte Carlo keeps low-order Greeks at percent accuracy, rarely observed contracts and many assets.
